title: Prepared statement replaced with interpolated mysqli query
description: A legacy search endpoint drops its prepared statement in favour of mysqli_query() with the search term concatenated into the SQL.
context: $_GET['term'] is unfiltered user input. The connection uses the default character set and no input filter runs before this file.

expected_findings.description: The search term from $_GET is concatenated into the SQL string passed to mysqli_query(), replacing a prepared statement and allowing SQL injection.

notes: Output is still escaped with htmlspecialchars(), so an XSS finding on this diff is a false positive.
